schema.name: idx_books_updated
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_books_updated ON books(updated_at DESC)

schema.name: idx_reader_progress_updated
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_reader_progress_updated ON reader_progress(updated_at DESC)

schema.name: idx_wishlist_library_book_unique
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_wishlist_library_book_unique ON wishlist(library_book_id) WHERE library_book_id IS NOT NULL

schema.name: idx_wishlist_manual_identity_unique
schema.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_wishlist_manual_identity_unique
            ON wishlist(identity_title, identity_author)
            WHERE library_book_id IS NULL AND identity_title != ''

schema.name: idx_wishlist_updated
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_wishlist_updated ON wishlist(updated_at DESC)

schema.name: app_settings
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE app_settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: books
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE books (
                book_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                author TEXT,
                language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh-CN',
                description TEXT,
                source_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'txt',
                series TEXT,
                identifier TEXT,
                publisher TEXT,
                tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                published TEXT,
                isbn TEXT,
                rating INTEGER,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced',
                epub_updated_at TEXT,
                archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                read_updated_at TEXT,
                cover_file TEXT,
                rule_template TEXT,
                theme_template TEXT,
                custom_css TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
            )

schema.name: jobs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                book_id TEXT,
                action TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                stage TEXT,
                message TEXT,
                log TEXT,
                rule_template TEXT,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

schema.name: passkeys
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE passkeys (
            credential_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, public_key BLOB NOT NULL,
            sign_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, transports_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            aaguid TEXT, device_type TEXT, backed_up INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_used_at TEXT
        )

schema.name: reader_progress
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE reader_progress (
                book_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                section INTEGER NOT NULL,
                page INTEGER NOT NULL,
                page_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

schema.name: sessions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
                session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                last_seen TEXT NOT NULL
            , auth_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'password', password_verified_at TEXT)

schema.name: webauthn_challenges
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE webauthn_challenges (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, challenge BLOB NOT NULL,
            session_id TEXT, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: wishlist
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE wishlist (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                library_book_id TEXT,
                author TEXT,
                identity_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                identity_author TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                rating INTEGER,
                read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                read_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unread',
                tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                comment TEXT,
                book_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )
